title: Adopt Asynchronous Event Sourcing via Kafka for Payment Processing
summary: Migrate all payment authorization, order confirmation, and ledger recording from synchronous REST calls to Kafka event streams to eliminate cascading outages and buffer sudden traffic spikes.
alternatives: 1. Synchronous REST with exponential backoff & circuit breakers (rejected due to memory pool bloat). 2. RabbitMQ message broker (rejected due to lack of replayability and partitioning scalability).

title: Cache Vault Transit Responses in Token Service to Absorb Key Rotation Latency
summary: Token Service now caches Vault transit engine responses in-process with a short TTL and falls back to a single-flight upstream call, so a key rotation no longer adds latency to every tokenization request.
alternatives: 1. Increase Token Service worker pool size (rejected; only masks the spike and increases Vault load). 2. Pin the Vault primary and rotate outside peak hours (rejected; rotation cadence is mandated by the PCI programme). 3. Pre-warm the transit key before rotation (rejected; requires privileged Vault access from the service tier).
